name: binhex-official-qbit-guard
description: A zero-dependency Python guard for qBittorrent that blocks pre-air TV episodes (Sonarr), deletes ISO/BDMV-only torrents, and auto-blocklists bad releases in Sonarr/Radarr (with dedupe + queue failover). Runs on "torrent added", fetches metadata safely, and logs everything to stdout.

variables.name: QBIT_HOST
variables.description: qBittorrent WebUI URL

variables.name: QBIT_USER
variables.description: qBittorrent WebUI username

variables.name: QBIT_PASS
variables.description: qBittorrent WebUI password

variables.name: QBIT_ALLOWED_CATEGORIES
variables.description: Comma-separated list of categories to process

variables.name: QBIT_DELETE_FILES
variables.description: Delete files when removing torrents

variables.name: QBIT_IGNORE_TLS
variables.description: Set to 1 to ignore SSL certificate errors

variables.name: QBIT_DRY_RUN
variables.description: Set to 1 for testing mode (no actual deletions)

variables.name: WATCH_POLL_SECONDS
variables.description: How often to check qBittorrent for new torrents (seconds)

variables.name: WATCH_PROCESS_EXISTING_AT_START
variables.description: Process existing torrents when container starts (0 or 1)

variables.name: WATCH_RESCAN_KEYWORD
variables.description: Keyword in category/tags to force reprocessing

variables.name: ENABLE_PREAIR_CHECK
variables.description: Enable pre-air checking (0 or 1)

variables.name: SONARR_URL
variables.description: Sonarr base URL

variables.name: SONARR_APIKEY
variables.description: Sonarr API key

variables.name: SONARR_CATEGORIES
variables.description: Categories to apply pre-air checks to

variables.name: EARLY_GRACE_HOURS
variables.description: Allow releases this many hours before air date

variables.name: EARLY_HARD_LIMIT_HOURS
variables.description: Block releases more than this many hours early

variables.name: WHITELIST_OVERRIDES_HARD_LIMIT
variables.description: Let whitelisted releases bypass hard limit (0 or 1)

variables.name: EARLY_WHITELIST_GROUPS
variables.description: Comma-separated list of trusted release groups

variables.name: EARLY_WHITELIST_INDEXERS
variables.description: Comma-separated list of trusted indexers

variables.name: EARLY_WHITELIST_TRACKERS
variables.description: Comma-separated list of trusted trackers

variables.name: RESUME_IF_NO_HISTORY
variables.description: Proceed if Sonarr history not found (0 or 1)

variables.name: SONARR_TIMEOUT_SEC
variables.description: HTTP timeout for Sonarr API calls

variables.name: SONARR_RETRIES
variables.description: Retry attempts for Sonarr operations

variables.name: RADARR_URL
variables.description: Radarr base URL

variables.name: RADARR_APIKEY
variables.description: Radarr API key

variables.name: RADARR_CATEGORIES
variables.description: Categories to apply Radarr blocklisting to

variables.name: RADARR_TIMEOUT_SEC
variables.description: HTTP timeout for Radarr API calls

variables.name: RADARR_RETRIES
variables.description: Retry attempts for Radarr operations

variables.name: INTERNET_CHECK_PROVIDER
variables.description: Provider selection: off, tvmaze, tvdb, or both

variables.name: TVMAZE_BASE
variables.description: TVmaze API base URL

variables.name: TVMAZE_TIMEOUT_SEC
variables.description: HTTP timeout for TVmaze API calls

variables.name: TVDB_BASE
variables.description: TheTVDB API base URL

variables.name: TVDB_APIKEY
variables.description: TheTVDB API key (required for TVDB)

variables.name: TVDB_PIN
variables.description: TheTVDB PIN (optional)

variables.name: TVDB_LANGUAGE
variables.description: Language code for TheTVDB

variables.name: TVDB_ORDER
variables.description: Episode order: default or official

variables.name: TVDB_TIMEOUT_SEC
variables.description: HTTP timeout for TheTVDB API calls

variables.name: TVDB_BEARER
variables.description: Reuse existing bearer token (optional)

variables.name: ENABLE_ISO_CHECK
variables.description: Enable ISO/disc image cleanup (0 or 1)

variables.name: MIN_KEEPABLE_VIDEO_MB
variables.description: Minimum size for video files to keep (MB)

variables.name: METADATA_POLL_INTERVAL
variables.description: Seconds between file list checks during metadata fetching

variables.name: METADATA_MAX_WAIT_SEC
variables.description: Max wait for metadata resolution (0 = infinite)

variables.name: METADATA_DOWNLOAD_BUDGET_BYTES
variables.description: Max bytes to download during metadata wait (0 = no limit)

variables.name: GUARD_EXT_STRATEGY
variables.description: Extension strategy: block or allow

variables.name: GUARD_ALLOWED_EXTS
variables.description: Comma-separated list of allowed extensions (for allow mode)

variables.name: GUARD_BLOCKED_EXTS
variables.description: Comma-separated list of blocked extensions (overrides defaults in block mode)

variables.name: GUARD_EXT_DELETE_IF_ALL_BLOCKED
variables.description: Delete only if all files are disallowed (0 or 1)

variables.name: GUARD_EXT_DELETE_IF_ANY_BLOCKED
variables.description: Delete if any file is disallowed (0 or 1)

variables.name: GUARD_EXT_VIOLATION_TAG
variables.description: Tag applied to torrents deleted for extension violations

variables.name: GUARD_DISC_EXTS
variables.description: Disc image extensions

variables.name: GUARD_EXTS_FILE
variables.description: Path to JSON config file (optional)

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Logging verbosity: INFO or DEBUG

variables.name: USER_AGENT
variables.description: HTTP User-Agent string for API calls

author: binhex
